a.lede: The Tor Project has released a security update for its network relay software to increase defenses against an ongoing distributed denial-of-service attack that it says has overwhelmed relays and affected most operators. [...]
a.title: Tor releases emergency update amid ongoing DDoS attack

b.lede: The PHP development team released security updates addressing 18 vulnerabilities, including critical flaws that could allow unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute code on vulnerable servers. [...]
b.title: PHP security updates fix 18 flaws, including critical RCE bugs
